# Valamis

> Valamis is an enterprise Learning Management System (LMS) platform designed for compliance, skills management, employee onboarding, and workforce development with AI-powered personalization and seamless integrations.

Valamis provides a comprehensive learning platform that combines content authoring, event management, mobile learning, and advanced analytics. The platform serves enterprises across industries including manufacturing, with integrations to major HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors, Salesforce, Workday, and Microsoft Teams.

## Key Topics

- Learning Management System (LMS)
- AI-Powered Learning
- Compliance Training
- Skills Management
- Employee Onboarding
- Personalized Learning Paths
- SAP SuccessFactors Integration
- Valamis Studio (Content Authoring)
- Learning Analytics
- Extended Enterprise Training
- Mobile Learning
- xAPI/Learning Record Store
- Employee Engagement
- GDPR & Data Security
- Microsoft Teams Integration

## Learning Solutions & Use Cases

- [Compliance Training Software for Enterprise | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/compliance-training): Compliance training with audit-ready reports and automated reminders.
- [Skill Management Platform | Upskill & Reskill with Data-Driven Insights](https://www.valamis.com/platform/skills-management): Skills management platform with gap analysis and workforce development.
- [Onboarding LMS | Employee Onboarding Software | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/onboarding): Employee onboarding with structured paths and automated check-ins.
- [Personalized Learning Platform Powered by Data | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/personalized-learning): Data-driven personalized learning paths and skill recommendations.
- [Product Training LMS | Train Customers & Partners | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/product-training): Customer and partner product training with certifications at scale.
- [Extended Enterprise LMS for Partner Training | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/extended-enterprise-training): Multi-tenant extended enterprise LMS for partners and resellers.
- [Employee Engagement Software | Valamis Learning Platform](https://www.valamis.com/platform/employee-engagement): Employee engagement through personalized learning and recognition tools.

## Platform Capabilities & Tools

- [LMS with Built-In Content Authoring Tool | Valamis Studio](https://www.valamis.com/platform/content-authoring-tool): Valamis Studio: drag-and-drop course creation with AI-powered features.
- [Training Scheduling & Event Management Software | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/event-management): Event management for instructor-led and virtual training scheduling.
- [Valamis Mobile App | Deliver Learning on the Go](https://www.valamis.com/platform/mobile-learning-app): Mobile app for anytime, anywhere learning with offline support.
- [LMS ROI & Cost-Efficient Learning Platform | Valamis](https://www.valamis.com/platform/cost-efficient-learning): LMS ROI metrics and cost-efficient learning solutions for L&D teams.
